Citizens are advised not to circulate unverified information and to rely only on official sources.

Delhi Police on truck seen near Jantar Mantar on July 20 ahead of Students’ protest:

“It is clarified that claims alleging that Truck No. HR63 E 6865 was deliberately deployed by Delhi Police near Jantar Mantar or outside any political party office are false and misleading.

The truck was seized in FIR No. 65/2026 on *16.07.2026* in connection with a road traffic accident involving the truck and an EECO van, in which six persons were injured earlier that day.

The seized vehicle was initially parked near PS Parliament Street for safe custody due to space constraints. Considering the law and order arrangements for the "Chalo Sansad" movement, it was later emptied and shifted to a safer place in the early hours of 20.07.2026, after due instructions to the owner.

Any claim linking the vehicle to a conspiracy against protesters is completely baseless.

Citizens are advised not to circulate unverified information and to rely only on official sources.”

A hospital is designated for treatment and you still register before the doctor sees you. Designation means the right is recognised. It does not mean rules disappear.

Permission is not suppression. It is order. And those who resist even that basic step are not protecting your right to protest. They are protecting their right to chaos.

body:
**Facts on Sonam Wangchuk hunger strike at Jantar Mantar:**

- Wangchuk began an **indefinite hunger strike** today (28 June 2026) at Jantar Mantar, joining the Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) protest over exam irregularities (e.g. NEET) and demanding accountability from Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan.

- CJP founder Abhijeet Dipke alleges Delhi Police cut water/sanitation after the strike started, public toilets have no water, and a portable toilet was denied despite health concerns for Wangchuk.

- **Delhi Police denial** (DCP New Delhi official tweet): The allegations are “falsehoods and misinformation.” Police have **no role** in providing or maintaining water or sanitation facilities at the site.

Public toilets and civic amenities at Jantar Mantar fall under municipal bodies (MCD), not Delhi Police. The CJP protest has run since 20 June with occasional prior facility complaints.

No independent confirmation of deliberate police cutoff today. This is allegation vs official denial.
